trials.claim: Lifetime access to Backlink Checker on Plan 1
trials.claimQuote:
Plan 1: $69 (was $1449)
- Lifetime access to Backlink Checker
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
trials.reasoning: The binding terms allow the vendor to terminate services and accounts at any time, which directly conflicts with guaranteed lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: We may modify or terminate our services at any time, for any reason, and without notice.
exhibits.argument: This allows the vendor to end the service at any time, which undermines a promise of lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: We reserve the right to terminate your account at any time.
exhibits.argument: This allows termination of the buyer account at any time, which contradicts guaranteed lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: That's why I was thrilled to discover this tool that I was hoping will provide peace of mind when it comes to link building - all for an LTD!
exhibits.argument: Quote confirms buyer purchased the tool as a lifetime deal (LTD).

trials.claim: Plan 1 includes 250 links per month crawled
trials.claimQuote: Monthly backlinks crawled - 250 links per month
trials.reasoning: The review only reports slow crawling over six days and does not show whether 250 links per month are included or denied.

exhibits.quote: I've spent six days waiting for a few links to crawl.
exhibits.argument: This reports that crawling does not happen promptly, undermining the promised monthly crawl allowance.

trials.claimQuote:
Monthly backlinks crawled - 250 links per month
- 5 Tracked Domains
- 100% automation - submit your links and forget!
trials.reasoning: A buyer reports a max-domain error while using only two domains despite a larger allowance, showing the tracked-domain limit is not honored as promised.

exhibits.quote: I started getting a “max domain count reached” error, even though I was only using two domains out of my 60-domain allowance.
exhibits.argument: This reports being blocked by domain limits well below the allowance, undermining the tracked-domains promise.

trials.claimQuote:
Lifetime access to Backlink Checker
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
- All future plan updates
trials.reasoning: The binding terms allow the vendor to modify or terminate services and change the terms without notice, materially undercutting a guarantee of all future plan updates despite reviews noting evolution.

exhibits.quote: We may modify or terminate our services at any time, for any reason, and without notice.
exhibits.argument: This lets the vendor change or end services without notice, undermining a promise of all future updates.

exhibits.quote: We reserve the right to modify these Terms of Service at any time without notice.
exhibits.argument: This lets the vendor change the deal terms unilaterally, undermining a guarantee of future plan updates.

exhibits.quote: The tool is constantly evolving and it was an excellent purchase.
exhibits.argument: Quote confirms the tool receives ongoing evolving updates after purchase.

exhibits.quote: It's clear that the developers are committed to making this tool even better over time, which means that we can look forward to even more features and functionalities that will help us ensure that our backlinks remain intact.
exhibits.argument: Quote confirms developers continue adding features over time as future updates.
